components.name: Token embedding
components.role: Maps each character to a learned vector.
components.note: Tied to the output head, so this block is counted once.

components.name: Rotary position embedding
components.role: Rotates queries and keys so attention scores depend on relative offset rather than absolute index.
components.note: No parameters at all -- position is encoded geometrically.

components.name: 4 x Causal self-attention
components.role: Each position gathers information from earlier positions.
components.note: Lower-triangular mask enforces that nothing attends forward.

components.name: 4 x SwiGLU feed-forward
components.note: Gated activation; ~8/3 expansion keeps parameters comparable to a 4x ReLU MLP.

components.name: 9 x RMSNorm
components.role: Stabilises activation scale before each sublayer.
components.note: Pre-norm placement is what makes the stack trainable without learning-rate warmup gymnastics.

components.name: Output head (tied)
components.note: Shares weights with the token embedding.

design_notes: RMSNorm over LayerNorm: no mean subtraction and no bias term.
Pre-norm residuals: normalise the sublayer input, not the residual sum.
RoPE over learned positions: relative offsets, graceful length extrapolation.
SwiGLU over ReLU: gated activation, better quality at equal parameters.
Weight tying: removes a whole vocab x embedding block and regularises.

attention.note: Row i shows where position i looked. Everything above the diagonal is exactly zero -- that is the causal mask, visible directly in the trained weights rather than asserted.

note: Attention maps are read from the trained weights, not illustrated schematically.
